reason: The README clearly presents MEMFLOW as a persistent, per-project memory and context framework for DeepSeek Harness, with prompt injection, memory recording, and optional subagent delegation; memory-context is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按项目持久化的会话记忆、上下文注入和可选的子智能体委派能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with persistent per-project session memory, context injection, and optional worker-agent delegation.

capabilities: Reads and injects project memory files into session context
Writes task states, decisions, status, notes, and history to project memory
Loads a configurable protocol into prompts
Spawns foreground or background worker subagents with prepared project context
